system.description:
As an action you may play a note on an instrument and all who hear its sound must make a Will roll against your Genjutsu or become Stunned. Creatures that pass their save against this technique are immune to it until their next rest. A creature with greater Arcane Might than you becomes immune to this technique after rolling to resist it, even if they fail their save.

If the target is Stressed they automatically fail their save against this ability. Creatures without Arcane Might and who are not Touched by Fate automatically fail their save against this ability.
